notes: Search budget: 19 of 25 web searches used. steelbenchmarker.com, barchart.com and spglobal.com could not be reached with WebFetch (DNS refused) - curl through the proxy reached steelbenchmarker.com; spglobal.com, plasticsnews.com, kallanish.com, northamericanstainless.com returned 403.

US anchors are SPOT, East-of-Mississippi / Midwest, FOB mill, in a tariff-driven squeeze (US HRC ~1,357 $/t v W. Europe 828 $/t and China 418 $/t on the same SteelBenchmarker date). OEM annual contracts may sit below spot; say so on any US book.

Canada and Mexico differ materially from the US: Section 232 (50%) split the Canadian market (Fastmarkets Canada index) and Mexico's domestic HRC (~US$985/t, Aug 2026) was ~30% below US spot. Their Al premiums differ too (Mexico cif ~$335/t v Midwest ~$2,315/t).
Polymer values are businessanalytiq regional indices (method not published) - treat as Low confidence; no US contract (Plastics News/CDI) or Brazilian domestic resin price was readable.
Brazil HRC is tax-inclusive (all except IPI) and stale (Mar 2026) - net ICMS / PIS-COFINS before use.
Not found: P&O extra, SBQ 1045 full price, 304/316/430 US base prices (surcharges found), 2026 billet premium, current A380, US copper premium, Brazilian CRC and Brazilian domestic resins.
Official layer: ECB FX for USD/CAD/MXN/BRL (29 Oct 2026) and LME cash (Westmetall, 29 Oct 2026) look consistent with the figures above; nothing wrong spotted.
